job.question: In the Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP for domestic equity small cap growth investment management, on what factors are respondents evaluated and ranked during the selection process?
job.expected_facts: Four primary factors: (a) People - stability of the organization, ownership structure and documented experience of key professionals; (b) Process - clearly defined, reasonable and repeatable investment strategy; (c) Performance - documented ability to meet investment performance benchmarks; (d) Pricing - fee schedule and associated costs.
job.acceptance: Accept People, Process, Performance, Pricing and faithful descriptions; exact labels are not mandatory.

reviews.reason: This is a California JPA sample investment-management RFP, not the IMRF RFP for domestic equity small cap growth management. Its six selection criteria do not establish the four factors used by IMRF.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR [Name of JPA]
[Name of JPA] is a California public agency organized under Government Code sections 6500-6515.

Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria: 1. Understanding the scope of the assignment, 2. Experience and qualifications of firm and individuals assigned, 3. Recommended approach to management of [Name of JPA]’s portfolio, 4. Familiarity with State investment and reporting requirements, 5. Performance history, and 6. Fees.
